summary: Defined degraded mode and local/stub fallback behavior for AgentOS so missing optional dependencies reduce capability without expanding authority or triggering unsafe host mutation.
acceptance_evidence: runtime-degraded-mode.md defines degraded classes for remote model, network, microVM, host package manager, adapter, remote audit and registry unavailability.
The contract preserves local/stub ModelBroker operation with network_required=false and remote provider optionality.
The degraded capability matrix keeps boot, projection, local audit, support bundle and read-only diagnostics available while blocking unverifiable high-risk effects.
Missing Firecracker or package-manager dependencies are specified to fail closed before EffectPrepared and cannot fall back to direct host execution.
Projection requirements expose degraded class, missing dependencies, limited capabilities, blocked effects, fallback provider and next operator action without authorizing action.

commands.summary: Functional capability replay passed and wrote .workflow/artifacts/functional-replay/result.json; covered capability, service recovery, package install, untrusted content, Firecracker, support bundle, operator projection and safety tests.
8 passed; stub provider plans without network/effects, malformed output and provider failures fail closed, call logs remain metadata-only and secrets are rejected.

blocked_shortcuts: No degraded mode broadens side-effect authority.
No missing optional dependency may trigger host mutation.
No missing microVM isolation may fall back to host execution.
No remote model is required for baseline acceptance.
No adapter-unavailable path may be substituted by agentd-owned business logic.
promotion_impact: Closes Wave 1 by defining how AgentOS remains locally operable and explainably degraded when optional Production Distro dependencies are unavailable.
